description: The suite's one dependency policy. Every repository extends this and configures nothing of its own.

packageRules.description: One pull request a month for everything that is not a major. Twelve separate bumps is twelve CI runs and twelve merges to move about forty lines; a major is the one case worth reading on its own.
A major is a behaviour change until somebody has read it. actions/checkout 4 to 7 crossed a Node runtime; that belongs in its own pull request.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix does not wait for the first of the month, and is not buried in a group of forty.
